data.research_question: Which current public organizations, public communication surfaces, and publicly identifiable organizational actors can be verified in the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs 479, 503, and 509 for the anarchist-violence area-code-hunt workflow?
data.method: Bounded deterministic shard-C area-code enumeration using current NANPA geographic membership, literal and locality-derived public web searches, first-party/current-status verification, repository dedupe, seed-family re-verification, and public-person cross-enumeration.
classification_rules: Historical directories are discovery seeds only; current-status verification is required before calling an organization active.
Do not infer individual political affiliation from proximity, attendance, membership, employment, volunteering, authorship, or public representation.
Do not merge organizations or people from name or handle similarity alone.
Inferred person-org relations remain explicitly marked candidate/inferred with confidence and uncertainty.
Area-code relations are geographic service-area associations unless a published phone number is directly evidenced.

findings.notes: Northwest Arkansas Food Not Bombs and Northwest Arkansas DSA retained. NWA FNB is current, decentralized, non-hierarchical Food Not Bombs mutual aid. NWA DSA exposes a mutual-aid working group and public social/contact surfaces. Partial first-name leadership listings were not promoted to person identities.

Portland Mutual Aid Network and Portland Anarchist Black Cross retained. Portland ABC is explicitly anarchist and has current/recent 2026 public event activity plus @abcportland. Greg Bennick's first-party bio explicitly identifies him as a PMAN co-founder.

Mutual Aid Survival Squad Spokane and Takeall Coalition retained. MASS has recent recurring direct-aid evidence and public Instagram. Takeall has current September 2026 activity, mutual-aid relief work, public email/text surfaces, and a current first-party team page. Alyssa Hensley's MASS relation remains candidate/inferred rather than a formal title.

data.narrative_role: bounded area-code organization enumeration pass with public-person cross-enumeration

provenance.method: area-code and locality public-source enumeration with public-role person cross-enumeration

summary: Bounded shard-C area-code enumeration pass covering current U.S. geographic NPAs 479, 503, and 509 with public-person cross-enumeration.
